notes.title: Chapter 2 Formal Release of Content
notes.notes:
The second chapter of the game content has been completed, and after several days of internal testing, most of the bugs have been resolved. It has now been updated to the official branch.



Friends who have already completed the first chapter can continue playing the content of the second chapter.



Thank you very much to those players who actively participated in the testing and provided feedback on the issues!



In addition, the official version of the game was previously taken down by Steam due to operational errors and has now been re released. The name of the official version of the game is tentatively set as "Divine and Demon Battle: Jianghu Journey". Interested friends, can you help add a wish list? Thank you very much!



The official version link is as follows:



https://store.steampowered.com/app/2838940/_/



In addition, friends who are interested in games and want to provide feedback, communication, and suggestions can also join QQ groups.

Game QQ group: 634019932
